seriesName: DRAM industry revenue growth by maker, Q1 2026 (quarter-on-quarter)
notes: This is contextual, not a direct measure of the >15% AI server price hike or the ~50% cumulative DRAM contract price claim in the bullet. It shows the memory-industry revenue surge (Q1 2026 vs Q4 2025, quarter-on-quarter, by maker) that underlies the cost pressure NVIDIA is reportedly passing on. The article's own DRAM contract-price figure ('approximately 93 to 98 percent') was excluded because it is a hedged range, not a bare published number, per the no-range rule. All points are actual reported Q1 2026 results (not forecasts) from a single page on evertiq.com, which the underlying data ultimately traces to TrendForce, but the citable, openly-readable page here is evertiq.com's own article, not trendforce.com.
